items.title: Can Silicon Valley Reinvent College for the AI Era?
items.title_ko: Can Silicon Valley Reinvent College for the AI Era?
items.summary_ko: The Horowitz Andreessen Academy is launching a new alternative to traditional college aimed at preparing young people for the AI economy. Backed by $42 million and supporters including Andreessen Horowitz, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Nvidia, the San Francisco-based program will focus on building with AI, interpersonal skills and hands-on projects rather than traditional majors.

items.title: ABB Motion President on New Data Center Technology
items.title_ko: ABB Motion President on New Data Center Technology
items.summary_ko: Brandon Spencer, President at ABB Motion, discusses ABB’s new portfolio of data center racks designed to support the growing power and computing needs of AI infrastructure. Spencer says rack-level power demand is rising dramatically, with deployments moving toward roughly one megawatt at the rack and power needs increasing five to six times from current levels.
